surfaces.coverage: M0.1 inspection of the exact compiler candidate and accepted staging base, candidate-PR correspondence, production-drift gate, specifically required migration-control state, material release or compatibility obligations, and Greg-only merge authority. Exact selected dependencies are material; unrelated branches, metadata, settings, workflows, and releases remain advisory unless they alter one of those dependencies.
limitations: Status inspected applies only to the stated M0.1 source dependency. Administration-only classic branch protection and repository Actions policy remain unverified and are not converted into inspected facts.
The 36-hour maximum bounds fast-moving repository-state evidence to one review cycle; it does not prove that no material event occurred within the window.

SRC-01 at owner_acceptance binds compiler candidate C commit d7aaf0ca79139b8ab3899aa5f5f6bf2092bdd598, tree ebaf5e4b7b6a7a09acc693db52e3cdc5e0ec2239, sole parent and accepted staging base B commit 609822762abd46c13ecd6187ccc8510695e52b2f and tree ebaf5e4b7b6a7a09acc693db52e3cdc5e0ec2239, and PR #98 targeting bowfin-migration-staging at that exact head and base. The expected current state is open, draft, and unmerged. A head, tree, parent, base, target, ancestry, unmerged closure, or unauthorized merge difference supplies source_candidate_binding_changed; inability to verify a required field supplies source_required_assessment_unavailable.

SRC-01 at pre_integration is stage-aware. The exact C/B/target/ancestry correspondence remains mandatory, but PR readiness may advance only through a separately retained Greg authorization. If an authorized source merge has occurred, the required exact merge correspondence replaces the earlier unmerged-state expectation; neither an authorized ready transition nor an authenticated authorized merge is itself drift.

SRC-02 binds compiler prod at commit 3c0a540df7d5ad75510db4ecad80e27fb4d0903a and tree 928accaa6c71068a6bce273f73f8c152b4c4d348 for this candidate. Any intervening prod change must be incorporated into staging and re-reviewed under the frozen contract; until that produces a new accepted base and candidate, the checkpoint supplies source_production_drift_unreconciled.

SRC-03 binds bowfin-migration-staging to the accepted base and requires the M1-M7 phase branches to remain at their recorded preauthorization state unless a separately retained Greg authorization establishes an expected transition. An unexplained change supplies source_migration_control_state_changed. Historical M0 branches and unrelated development branches are advisory.

Candidate-tree workflow blobs are authenticated through immutable C and do not require comparison with an unrelated live workflow collection. A release or external source facility change supplies source_compatibility_obligation_changed only when it creates or alters a concrete migration or compatibility obligation; generic release metadata or unrelated repository churn is advisory.

SRC-04 requires Greg to remain the sole merge authority and automated or expanded merge authority to remain absent. A known contrary process or control change supplies source_merge_authority_changed. Inaccessible administration settings remain unverified and cannot be cited as proof either way.

Every checkpoint record must identify SRC-01 through SRC-04, the evidence inspected, true, false, or unknown outcome, and the exact event set supplied. An empty event set alone is not evidence that the required assessment occurred.
The observation does not establish future mergeability, repository-rename redirects, raw-link redirects, hosted-Action consumers, or administration-only policy.

surfaces.coverage: M0.1 inspection of the seven contract-selected domain names and their primary, secondary-redirect, and legacy-compatibility roles, plus retained public RDAP expiration/status and DNS-delegation facts. Continued selected identity and known threats to custody or retained compatibility are material; routine RDAP timestamps/status normalization, ordinary DNS churn, parking content, TLS, redirects, and served content are advisory or later M6 concerns.
limitations: Status inspected applies only to the selected portfolio and retained public RDAP and DNS facts. Public RDAP does not establish registrar-account ownership or control, and M0.1 does not establish TLS, redirects, served content, or cutover readiness.
The seven-day maximum bounds M0.1 planning evidence; it grants no legal clearance or M6 operational authority and does not prove that no material event occurred within the window.

DOM-01 at owner_acceptance and pre_integration requires bowfin-lang.com to remain the selected primary identity; bowfin-lang.org, bowfin-lang.net, bowfin-lang.info, and bowfin-lang.online to remain selected secondary redirect candidates; and klyxr.com and klyxr.online to remain selected legacy compatibility entry points. Removal or role reassignment of a required name supplies selected_domain_portfolio_changed; an additional unrelated domain does not.

DOM-02 requires the explicit evaluation instant to precede every retained selected-domain expiration time. An expiration at or before evaluation, or known loss, lapse, redemption, transfer, suspension, or other concrete custody threat, supplies selected_domain_custody_threatened even while the snapshot remains within seven days.

DOM-03 treats a known unauthorized or unexplained delegation, nameserver, or comparable change as legacy_domain_compatibility_threatened only when it threatens the required klyxr.com or klyxr.online compatibility obligation. Routine add-period expiration, RDAP last-changed movement, ordinary DNS answers, nameserver churn, or parking-content changes are advisory unless evidence establishes that threat.

No mandatory live RDAP or DNS rerun is required while the bound observation remains within seven days and no material event is known. If credible known information makes DOM-01, DOM-02, or DOM-03 genuinely unresolvable, the checkpoint supplies domain_material_predicate_unresolved; an unavailable unselected advisory endpoint alone does not.

Every checkpoint record must identify DOM-01 through DOM-03, the retained and any newly known evidence inspected, true, false, or unknown outcome, and the exact event set supplied. An empty event set alone is not evidence that the required assessment occurred.
M6 must separately verify registrar hardening, cutover DNS, TLS, redirects, served content, prerequisites, verification, and recovery before any separately authorized public cutover.

surfaces.coverage: M0.1 bounded collision reconnaissance across named package, editor-tooling, application-store, social-identity, and attempted trademark-search surfaces. Material M0.1 predicates are limited to credible direct Bowfin programming-language/compiler/toolchain collisions and preservation of explicit publication exclusions. The planned gregkrsak/bowfin destination remains selected by contract, but its current availability or control is deferred to the repository-renaming phase and is not asserted by this observation.
limitations: Status inspected means the bounded M0.1 reconnaissance procedure and its unavailable or inconclusive results were inspected and retained. It does not certify an unavailable service, legal clearance, global non-conflict, or registry availability.
The seven-day maximum bounds advisory collision reconnaissance; it does not prove that no material event occurred within the window.

PUB-01 treats a project as a direct collision only when credible public evidence shows it using Bowfin as a primary programming-language, compiler, toolchain, or primary developer-tooling identity in a manner that competes with the adopted Bowfin language identity. An unrelated fish, museum, business, repository, or unrelated software project is advisory. A confirmed direct collision supplies bowfin_language_identity_collision_detected; a credible ambiguous project that cannot be classified confidently supplies bowfin_language_identity_collision_unresolved.

PUB-02 preserves the current M0.1 publication scope and exclusions: the bare npm package bowfin is occupied and unclaimed; bowfin-compiler remains registry-unpublished with Cargo publish=false; org.bowfin is a known future application-identity exclusion; and no PyPI, crates.io, editor-extension, application-store, social-media, or other public identity is selected by M0.1. A change that selects or claims one of those identities without separately reviewed evidence and authority supplies public_identity_scope_or_exclusion_changed; inability to establish the required scope or exclusion state supplies public_identity_scope_or_exclusion_unresolved.

The planned destination gregkrsak/bowfin remains a contract-selected future identity, but the broad retained GitHub search does not prove its availability, control, or rename readiness. That current predicate is deferred to the phase that performs repository renaming; if an earlier phase begins to rely on it, new exact-subject evidence and renewed policy review are required.

General result counts, ordering, unrelated Bowfin repositories, advisory endpoint failures, and changes at unselected package, editor, application-store, social, supplemental-search, or trademark surfaces are retained reconnaissance but do not themselves supply an invalidating event.

No mandatory live rerun of the retained registry queries is required while the bound observation remains within seven days and no PUB-01 or PUB-02 event is known. Expiry still rejects. USPTO remains unavailable and outside any M0.1 clearance claim; separate legal or trademark clearance is required if a later phase relies upon it.

Every checkpoint record must identify PUB-01 and PUB-02, the retained and any newly known evidence inspected, true, false, or unknown outcome, and the exact event set supplied. An empty event set alone is not evidence that the required assessment occurred.

surfaces.coverage: M0.1 bounded discovery of indexed public default-branch hosted-Action consumers through the retained authenticated GitHub code searches. Material predicates concern actual external workflow dependencies and their retained compatibility obligations; result counts, tokenization false positives, prose links, index ordering or visibility, unrelated paths, and repeat-search availability are advisory.
limitations: Status inspected means the bounded discovery procedure and its limitations were retained. GitHub search can omit private, unindexed, fork, deleted, non-default-branch, generated, or syntactically varied consumers; an empty known-consumer list is not a universal absence finding.
The seven-day maximum bounds planning evidence and cannot authorize removal of compatibility support or prove that no material event occurred within the window.

CON-01 classifies a real consumer as an external repository workflow using gregkrsak/klyxr@ followed by a revision, including an applicable supported action subpath. A newly identified real consumer supplies hosted_action_consumer_discovered. Internal prose, ordinary repository links, tokenization false positives, and unrelated search results do not.

CON-02 requires every previously identified actual consumer and its recorded dependency to retain an explicit compatibility disposition. A dependency change or disappearance that affects a recorded obligation supplies hosted_action_consumer_dependency_changed; disappearance never authorizes compatibility removal. A plausible actual consumer or dependency that cannot be confidently classified supplies hosted_action_consumer_dependency_unresolved.
The current retained known-external-consumer list is empty. No complete external-consumer population has been proven.

No mandatory repeat GitHub code search is required while the bound observation remains within seven days and no CON-01 or CON-02 event is known. Search unavailability, count changes, path ordering, and index visibility are advisory; expiry still rejects.

Every checkpoint record must identify CON-01 and CON-02, the retained and any newly known evidence inspected, true, false, or unknown outcome, and the exact event set supplied. An empty event set alone is not evidence that the required assessment occurred.
